definition: The title: Portuguese for "the jaguar game".
context: Title. Proper name in every language.

definition: The hunter in Adugo (adugo in Bororo; onça in Portuguese).
The hunted side: fourteen dogs in Adugo, twelve in Komikan.
The hunter in Komikan (komikelu; león in the Chilean sources).
Komikan's triangle (la torre in the Spanish sources).
The Bororo name of the game and of the jaguar.
The Mapuche people of Chile and Argentina.
The Bororo people of Mato Grosso, Brazil.
